blurb: Located near Medina Dam in southern Medina Lake, Red Cove Cafe & Marina offers boat slips, dry storage with launching privileges, a fueling station, and the only restaurant and store accessible from the water. The marina has 50 covered boat slips and 16 enclosed dry storage slips. The café provides food and beverages with friendly service.
